Synthesis:
Guarantees: 1) admit() validates contract.scope via validate() before pinning; 2) retire() enforces atomic rejection of session-roots, pinned objects, and ready/running tasks; 3) retired keys append to state atomically.
Limitations: 1) admit() lacks scope validation for sandbox/dependency state checks; 2) retire() does not validate non-scheduled in-flight tasks holding references post-retirement.
Test: Assert retire() succeeds when called on an object held by a task in 'processing' (in-flight) state, demonstrating the in-flight gap.
